summary_en: YONEX declared an interim dividend of 17 yen per share for the period ended September 30, 2026, comprising 14 yen ordinary dividend and 3 yen commemorative dividend to mark the company's 80th anniversary, bringing full-year dividend forecast to 31 yen per share.
title_en: Notice Regarding Surplus Dividends (Interim Dividend and Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, YONEX's Board of Directors resolved to pay an interim dividend of 17 yen per share with a record date of September 30, 2026. The dividend comprises 14 yen as ordinary dividend and 3 yen as commemorative dividend. The commemorative component marks the company's 80th anniversary.

The company's basic dividend policy is to maintain stable and appropriate dividend levels as an important management strategy for returning profits to shareholders. The dividend will be paid from retained earnings with an effective date of December 10, 2026. Total dividend amount is 1,458 million yen.

With this interim dividend, the full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 is revised to 31 yen per share, comprising 28 yen ordinary dividend and 3 yen commemorative dividend.
